source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 4 (PDF 75-92), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 4 (Work, Energy and Power) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.
4.1 Work done by a constant force

blocks.prompt:
1 Define work done by a constant force. Write its formula when the force is along the displacement.
(Constant force ke work ki definition likhein. Jab force displacement ke rukh mein ho to is ka formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab constant force F kisi jism ko apni simt mein d faasla le jaye to work (kaam) force aur displacement (haqeeqi faasla) ki magnitudes ka hasil-e-zarb hai: W = Fd. Work do cheezon par mushtamil hai: force aur displacement.

book_ref.quote: work W is defined as the product of the magnitude of the force F and magnitude of the displacement d

blocks.prompt:
2 A person pushing a wall gets tired, yet no work is done on the wall. Explain.
(Deewar dhakelne wala thak jata hai, phir bhi deewar par koi work nahi hota. Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: W = Fd. Deewar nahi hilti, is liye d = 0. Displacement sifar ho to bari force ke bawajood work sifar hota hai; pathe thak jate hain magar deewar par work sifar hai.

book_ref.quote: pushing on a wall may tire your muscles, but work done is zero

blocks.prompt:
3 Write the formula for work when the force F makes an angle θ with the displacement d. Show that work is a scalar.
(Jab force F displacement d se θ angle banaye to work ka formula likhein. Dikhayein ke work scalar hai.)
blocks.explanation: Sirf displacement ke rukh wala component F cos θ work karta hai: W = Fd cos θ. Vector shakal mein W = F⃗·d⃗; do vectors ka scalar (dot) product scalar hota hai, is liye work scalar quantity hai.

book_ref.quote: If the force F makes an angle θ with the displacement d

blocks.prompt:
4 Define the joule.
(Joule ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Joule work ki SI unit hai: 1 J = 1 N m. Jab 1 N ki force jism ko apni simt mein 1 m le jaye to 1 joule work hota hai (W = Fd se).

book_ref.quote: SI unit of work is N m known as joule (J).

blocks.prompt:
5 Under what conditions is the work done by a force positive, zero and negative?
(Force ka work kab positive, kab sifar aur kab negative hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: W = Fd cos θ se: θ < 90° par work positive; θ = 90° par cos θ = 0, work sifar; θ > 90° par cos θ manfi, work negative.

book_ref.quote: If θ = 90°, no work is done.

blocks.prompt:
6 Differentiate between positive work and negative work.
(Positive work aur negative work mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Positive work: θ < 90°; negative work: θ > 90°.

book_ref.quote: If θ > 90°, the work done is said to be negative.

rows: Force aur displacement ka angle θ 90° se kam.
Force aur displacement ka angle θ 90° se zyada.
cos θ musbat, is liye W musbat.
cos θ manfi, is liye W manfi.
Misaal: girte jism par gravity.
Misaal: phisalte jism par friction (θ = 180°).

blocks.prompt:
7 How can the work done by a constant force be found from a force-displacement graph?
(Force-displacement graph se constant force ka work kaise maloom karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: x-axis par displacement aur y-axis par force. Constant force ufqi seedhi line deti hai aur us ke neeche rectangle ka area F × d = Fd, yani work hai. Is liye graph ke neeche ka area work zahir karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Hence, the area under a force-displacement curve can be taken as to represent the work done by the constant force.

blocks.prompt:
8 A force of 60 N pulls a box 4 m along the floor at 60° to the displacement. Find the work done.
(60 N ki force aik dabbe ko farsh par displacement se 60° par 4 m kheenchti hai. Work nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: the work done is equal to the product of the component of force along the direction of the displacement

blocks.prompt:
9 A frictional force of 12 N acts on a block as it slides 5 m. Find the work done by friction and state its sign.
(Aik block 5 m phisalta hai aur us par 12 N ki friction amal karti hai. Friction ka work aur us ka nishan batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Friction harkat ke ulat hai, θ = 180°.
W = 12 × 5 × (−1) = −60 J
θ > 90° hai is liye work manfi hai.

book_ref.quote: From the definition of work, we find that:

blocks.text: 4.2 Work done by a variable force

blocks.prompt:
10 What is a variable force? Give two examples from the chapter.
(Variable force kya hai? Chapter se do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Variable force woh hai jo work karte hue constant na rahe. Misalein: (i) Zameen se door jate rocket par gravity, jo markaz se faasle ke inverse square ke mutabiq badalti hai; (ii) spring ki force, jo khinchao ke saath barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: In many cases the force does not remain constant during the process of doing work.

blocks.prompt:
11 How is the work done by a variable force found graphically?
(Variable force ka work graph se kaise maloom kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Displacement ko chhote hisson Δd mein baanta jata hai jin mein force taqreeban constant ho; har hisse ka work rectangle ka area Fᵢ cos θᵢ Δdᵢ hai. Inhein jama karke Δd → 0 karne se P aur Q ke darmiyan F cos θ banam d curve ke neeche ka area milta hai, yahi work hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, the work done by a variable force in moving a particle between two points is equal to the area under the F cos θ versus d curve

blocks.prompt:
12 Why does the sum of rectangles give a more exact value of work when Δd is made smaller?
(Δd chhota karne se rectangles ka jama work ki zyada durust qeemat kyun deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har hisse mein force sirf taqreeban constant hai. Chhote Δd mein force kam badalti hai, is liye rectangles curve se behtar milte hain. Δd → 0 par jama bilkul durust ho jata hai (Eq. 4.5).

book_ref.quote: If we let each Δd to approach zero, then we obtain an exact result for the work done

blocks.prompt:
13 A force is 6 N from d = 0 to d = 5 m and then decreases uniformly to zero at d = 8 m. Find the work done from d = 0 to d = 8 m.
(Force d = 0 se 5 m tak 6 N hai aur phir yaksaan tor par d = 8 m par sifar ho jati hai. d = 0 se 8 m tak work nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Work = curve ke neeche ka area
Rectangle: 6 × 5 = 30 J
Triangle: ½ × 3 × 6 = 9 J
Kul work = 39 J

book_ref.quote: This area is equal to the area of the rectangular section from d = 0 to d = 4 m

blocks.prompt:
14 What is the gravitational field? When is the work done by gravity positive and when negative?
(Gravitational field kya hai? Gravity ka work kab positive aur kab negative hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zameen ke ird gird woh jagah jahan us ki gravitational force jism par amal kare gravitational field (kashish-e-saql ka maidan) hai. Displacement gravity ki simt mein ho (girna) to work positive; gravity ke khilaf ho (uthna) to work negative.

book_ref.quote: The space around the Earth in which its gravitational force acts on a body is called the gravitational field.

blocks.prompt:
15 Define a conservative force and give three examples.
(Conservative force ki definition likhein aur teen misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Force conservative (mahfooz) hai agar do points ke darmiyan us ka work raaste par munhasir na ho, ya band raaste mein us ka work sifar ho. Misalein: gravitational force, electrostatic force, elastic spring force.

book_ref.quote: If the work done by a force in moving an object between two points is independent of the path followed

blocks.prompt:
16 When a curved path in the gravitational field is broken into small steps, why is no work done by gravity along the horizontal steps?
(Gravitational field mein ghumawdaar raaste ko chhote qadmon mein torne par ufqi qadmon par gravity ka work kyun nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Ufqi qadam par weight mg displacement par amoodi hai (θ = 90°, cos 90° = 0), is liye W = 0. Gravity sirf amoodi qadmon par work karti hai, jin ka jama h hai, is liye h oonchai par −mgh.

book_ref.quote: There is no work done along the horizontal steps, because mg is perpendicular to the displacement for these steps.

blocks.prompt:
17 Show that the work done by gravity along a closed path such as ACBA is zero.
(Dikhayein ke ACBA jaise band raaste par gravity ka work sifar hai.)
blocks.explanation: A se B (oonchai h) raasta ACB: W = −mgh. B se wapas A (girna h): displacement mg ki simt mein, W = +mgh. Kul = −mgh + mgh = 0. Is liye gravity conservative force hai.

book_ref.quote: Can you prove that the work done, along a closed path, such as ACBA or ADBA (Fig. 4.9), by the gravitational force is zero?

blocks.prompt:
18 A 3 kg box is raised 4 m, once by a vertical lift and once along a long ramp. Find the work done by gravity in each case.
(3 kg ka dabba 4 m ooncha uthaya jata hai, aik dafa seedha lift se aur aik dafa lambe ramp se. Har soorat mein gravity ka work nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Gravity ka work raaste par munhasir nahi.
W = −mgh = −3 × 9.8 × 4 = −117.6 J ≈ −118 J dono soorat mein.

book_ref.quote: Work done by gravitational force is independent of the path followed.

blocks.prompt:
19 Define a non-conservative force and give three examples.
(Non-conservative force ki definition likhein aur teen misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Force non-conservative (ghair-mahfooz) hai agar do points ke darmiyan ya band raaste mein us ka work raaste par munhasir ho. Misalein: kinetic friction (ragar), hawa ki mazahmat, dhaage ka tension (aur normal force, rocket ki propulsion force).

book_ref.quote: A force is non-conservative if the work done by it in moving an object between two points or in a closed path depends on the path of motion.

blocks.prompt:
20 A crate is dragged from P to Q against a friction of 6 N along a straight 5 m path and along a curved 9 m path. Find the work done by friction in each case. What does the result show?
(Aik crate ko 6 N friction ke khilaf P se Q tak 5 m seedhe aur 9 m ghumawdaar raaste se ghaseeta jata hai. Dono soorat mein friction ka work nikalein. Nateeja kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Friction ka manfi work = f × raaste ki lambai.
Seedha: −30 J; ghumawdaar: −54 J
Work raaste par munhasir hai, is liye friction non-conservative hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, greater amount of work is done over a longer path between any two points.

blocks.prompt:
21 Differentiate between conservative and non-conservative forces.
(Conservative aur non-conservative forces mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Conservative: work raaste se azad; non-conservative: work raaste par munhasir.

book_ref.quote: the force is called a conservative force

rows: Do points ke darmiyan work raaste par munhasir nahi.
Do points ke darmiyan work raaste par munhasir hai.
Band raaste mein work sifar.
Band raaste mein work sifar nahi.
Misalein: gravitational, electrostatic, elastic spring force.
Misalein: kinetic friction, hawa ki mazahmat, tension, normal force, rocket propulsion.

blocks.prompt:
22 Define power and average power. Is power a scalar or a vector?
(Power aur average power ki definition likhein. Power scalar hai ya vector?)
blocks.explanation: Power (taaqat) woh sharah hai jis se work kiya ja raha ho. Agar Δt waqt mein ΔW work ho to average power P_av = ΔW/Δt. Power scalar hai kyunke work aur time dono scalar hain.

book_ref.quote: Power is the measure of the rate at which work is being done.

blocks.prompt:
23 Define instantaneous power.
(Instantaneous power ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Agar work time ka function ho to kisi lamhe par instantaneous (lamhaati) power ΔW/Δt ki limit hai jab Δt → 0: P = lim (Δt → 0) ΔW/Δt, jahan ΔW chhote waqfe Δt mein work hai.

book_ref.quote: If work is expressed as a function of time, the instantaneous power P at any instant is defined as:

blocks.prompt:
24 Show that power is the dot product of force and velocity.
(Sabit karein ke power force aur velocity ka dot product hai.)
blocks.explanation: P = ΔW/Δt aur ΔW = F⃗·Δd⃗, is liye P = F⃗·(Δd⃗/Δt). Δd⃗/Δt = v⃗, to P = F⃗·v⃗ (Eq. 4.8).

book_ref.quote: where ΔW is the work done in short interval of time Δt.

blocks.prompt:
25 Define the watt. Express it in base units.
(Watt ki definition likhein. Ise base units mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Watt power ki SI unit hai: aik second mein aik joule work, 1 W = 1 J s⁻¹. Base units mein 1 W = 1 kg m² s⁻³.

book_ref.quote: The SI unit of power is watt, defined as one joule of work done in one second.

blocks.prompt:
26 Define kilowatt-hour and show that 1 kW h = 3.6 MJ.
(Kilowatt-hour ki definition likhein aur dikhayein ke 1 kW h = 3.6 MJ.)
blocks.explanation:
Aik kilowatt-hour woh work hai jo aik kilowatt power wala adara (agency) aik ghante mein kare; yeh bijli ki energy ki commercial unit hai.
1 kW h = 1000 W × 3600 s = 3.6 × 10⁶ J = 3.6 MJ

book_ref.quote: One kilowatt- hour is the work done in one hour by an agency whose power is one kilowatt.

blocks.prompt:
27 Why is power more useful than work alone in practical applications?
(Amali kaamon mein sirf work ke muqable mein power zyada mufeed kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Work ki definition yeh nahi batati ke kaam aik second mein hua ya aik ghante mein. Amal mein hamein jaanna hota hai ke kaam kitni tezi se hua, yani kaam ki sharah, jo power hai.

book_ref.quote: In the definition of work, it is not clear, whether the same amount of work is done in one second or in one hour.

blocks.prompt:
28 Differentiate between work and power.
(Work aur power mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Work force × displacement hai; power work ki sharah hai.

book_ref.quote: If work ΔW is done in a time interval Δt

rows: Force aur displacement ka hasil-e-zarb: W = F⃗·d⃗.
Work ki sharah: P = ΔW/Δt = F⃗·v⃗.
Yeh nahi batata ke kaam kitni tezi se hua.
Batati hai ke kaam kitni tezi se hua.
SI unit: joule (J).
SI unit: watt (W) = J s⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
29 A 65 kg student climbs stairs of vertical height 5.0 m in 6.5 s. Find the student's power output.
(65 kg ka talib-e-ilm 5.0 m oonchi seerhiyan 6.5 s mein charhta hai. Us ki power nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The vertical height of the stairs is 4.5 m. Calculate his power output in watts.

blocks.prompt:
30 A boat engine exerts a forward force of 800 N while the boat moves at a steady 15 m s⁻¹ in the same direction. Find the power of the engine.
(Kashti ka engine 800 N aage ki force lagata hai aur kashti usi rukh mein 15 m s⁻¹ se chal rahi hai. Engine ki power nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: where ΔW is the work done in short interval of time Δt.

blocks.prompt:
31 A 1.5 kW iron is used for 4 hours. Find the energy used in kW h and in joules.
(1.5 kW ki istri 4 ghante istemal hoti hai. Kharch shuda energy kW h aur joules mein nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: However, a commercial unit of electrical energy is kilowatt-hour.

blocks.prompt:
32 Define energy. Name its two basic forms.
(Energy ki definition likhein. Is ki do bunyadi qismein batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Jism ki energy (tawanai) us ki kaam karne ki salahiyat hai. Is ki do bunyadi qismein kinetic energy aur potential energy hain; dono mechanical energy ki qismein hain.

book_ref.quote: Energy of a body is its capacity to do work.

blocks.prompt:
33 Differentiate between kinetic energy and potential energy.
(Kinetic energy aur potential energy mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Kinetic energy harkat ki wajah se; potential energy position ya majboor haalat ki wajah se.

book_ref.quote: Kinetic energy is the energy possessed by a body due to its motion

rows: Harkat ki wajah se jism ki energy.
Badli hui position ya majboor haalat ki wajah se energy.
K.E. = ½mv².
Zameen ke qareeb P.E. = mgh; absolute P.E. U = −GMm/r.
Misaal: chalti car.
Misaal: dabaya hua spring (elastic P.E.).

blocks.prompt:
34 Why is the kinetic energy of a car taken equal to fd, where f is friction and d the stopping distance?
(Car ki kinetic energy fd (f friction, d rukne ka faasla) ke barabar kyun li jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Engine band hone ke baad bhi chalti car friction f ke khilaf d faasla tay karke rukti hai aur fd work karti hai. Yeh work harkat ki wajah se hai; harkat ki wajah se kaam karne ki salahiyat kinetic energy hai, is liye K.E. = fd.

book_ref.quote: As long as it is moving, it is doing work against the force of friction of the road.

blocks.prompt:
35 Why is the unit of kinetic energy the same as that of work?
(Kinetic energy ki unit work wali kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kinetic energy us work ke barabar hai jo jism apni harkat ki wajah se kar sakta hai. Is liye is ki unit work wali, yani joule (J), hai.

book_ref.quote: Since, kinetic energy is equal to work which the body is capable of doing

blocks.prompt:
36 A cricket ball of mass 0.15 kg moves at 20 m s⁻¹. Find its kinetic energy.
(0.15 kg ki cricket ball 20 m s⁻¹ se chal rahi hai. Us ki kinetic energy nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Let us derive a formula for the kinetic energy of a moving body.

blocks.prompt:
37 How does the kinetic energy of a body change if its speed is made three times?
(Agar jism ki speed teen guna kar di jaye to us ki kinetic energy kaise badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: K.E. ∝ v². v teen guna ho to K.E. = ½m(3v)² = 9 guna.

book_ref.quote: The ability of a body to do work due to its motion is its kinetic energy.

blocks.prompt:
38 A car of weight 11760 N moving at 12 m s⁻¹ is stopped by its brakes in 36 m. Find the average force of friction.
(11760 N weight ki car 12 m s⁻¹ se chal rahi hai aur brakes se 36 m mein rukti hai. Friction ki average force nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Determine the average force of friction acting on it.

blocks.prompt:
39 What is elastic potential energy? Give an example.
(Elastic potential energy kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Jism ki majboor (dabi ya khinchi) haalat ki wajah se potential energy elastic potential energy (lachakdaar makhfi tawanai) hai. Misaal: dabaye hue spring mein jama energy.

book_ref.quote: The energy stored in a compressed spring is the potential energy possessed by the spring due to its compressed or stretched state.

blocks.prompt:
40 Define absolute gravitational potential energy and write its formula.
(Absolute gravitational potential energy ki definition aur formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kisi position par jism ki absolute gravitational potential energy gravity ka woh work hai jo use us position se infinity tak le jane mein ho, jahan gravity sifar ho jati hai. U = −GMm/r, jahan r Zameen ke markaz se faasla hai.

book_ref.quote: The absolute gravitational potential energy of an object at a certain position is the work done by the gravitational force

blocks.prompt:
41 Why can P.E. = mgh not be used when a body is moved through a large distance in space?
(Jab jism ko space mein bohat bara faasla le jaya jaye to P.E. = mgh kyun istemal nahi ho sakta?)
blocks.explanation: mgh sirf Zameen ki satah ke qareeb durust hai jahan gravity taqreeban constant hai. Bare faasle par gravity constant nahi rehti; faasle ke murabba ke ulat badalti hai, is liye chhote qadmon ka work jama karna parta hai.

book_ref.quote: But if the body is displaced through a large distance in space

blocks.prompt:
42 Why is the absolute gravitational potential energy negative?
(Absolute gravitational potential energy manfi kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: U = −GMm/r. Infinity par P.E. sifar hai aur jism ko wahan le jane ke liye gravity ke khilaf work karna parta hai, is liye is se neeche P.E. sifar se kam hai. Manfi nishan batata hai ke Zameen ka field kheenchne wala (attractive) hai.

book_ref.quote: The negative sign shows that the Earth's gravitational field for mass m is attractive.

blocks.prompt:
43 How does the absolute P.E. of a body change when it is raised above the Earth's surface?
(Jism ko Zameen ki satah se ooncha karne par us ki absolute P.E. kaise badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: U = −GMm/r. r barhne se U kam manfi, yani barhta hai. Is liye uthane se P.E. barhti hai; satah se GMm/R work karne ke baad infinity par sifar ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: It means when we raise a body above the surface of the Earth, its P.E. increases.

blocks.prompt:
44 In the derivation of absolute P.E., show that r² = r₁r₂ for a small step.
(Absolute P.E. ki derivation mein dikhayein ke chhote qadam ke liye r² = r₁r₂.)
blocks.explanation: r = r₁ + Δr/2, r² = r₁² + r₁Δr + (Δr/2)². (Δr)² << r₁², is liye chhor dein: r² = r₁² + r₁Δr. Δr = r₂ − r₁ rakhne se r² = r₁r₂.

book_ref.quote: As (Δr)² << r₁², so (Δr)² can be neglected as compared to r₁².

blocks.prompt:
45 A 2 kg bag is lifted from the floor to a shelf 6 m high. Find the gain in its potential energy.
(2 kg ka thaila farsh se 6 m oonchi shelf par rakha jata hai. Us ki potential energy mein izafa nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The relation for the calculation of the work done by the gravitational force or potential energy is mgh

blocks.prompt:
46 Differentiate between gravitational P.E. near the Earth (mgh) and absolute gravitational P.E.
(Zameen ke qareeb gravitational P.E. (mgh) aur absolute gravitational P.E. mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: mgh satah ke qareeb; −GMm/r har faasle par aur infinity par sifar.

book_ref.quote: where its potential energy with respect to Earth is zero

rows: Sirf satah ke qareeb durust jahan gravity taqreeban constant hai.
Markaz se har faasle r par durust; gravity 1/r² ke mutabiq badalti hai.
Kisi chune hue level (maslan zameen) se napi jati hai.
Infinity par P.E. sifar maan kar napi jati hai.
Chune hue level se oopar musbat.
Hamesha manfi; r barhne se kam manfi hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
47 Define escape velocity. What is its approximate value for the Earth?
(Escape velocity ki definition likhein. Zameen ke liye is ki taqreebi qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Woh ibtidai velocity jis se jism Zameen ke gravitational field se bahar nikal jaye escape velocity (farar ki raftaar) hai. Zameen ke liye taqreeban 11 km s⁻¹ (table mein 11.2 km s⁻¹).

book_ref.quote: The initial velocity of an object with which it goes out of the Earth's gravitational field, is known as escape velocity.

blocks.prompt:
48 Why does an object thrown upward come back, and when will it not come back?
(Oopar phenki gayi cheez wapas kyun aati hai, aur kab wapas nahi aayegi?)
blocks.explanation: Gravity neeche ki taraf amal karti hai is liye wapas aati hai. Zyada ibtidai velocity se zyada ooncha jati hai; agar velocity escape velocity tak barha di jaye to wapas nahi aati aur gravity ke asar se nikal jati hai.

book_ref.quote: This is due to the force of gravity acting downward.

blocks.prompt:
49 Does the escape velocity depend on the mass of the projected body? Explain.
(Kya escape velocity phenke gaye jism ke mass par munhasir hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. ½mv_esc² = GMm/R mein jism ka mass m cancel ho jata hai; v_esc = √(2GM/R) = √(2gR) sirf Zameen ke mass M (ya g) aur radius R par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: The body will escape out of the gravitational field if the initial K.E. of the body is equal to increase in P.E.

blocks.prompt:
50 Why do the Moon and Jupiter have very different escape speeds?
(Chaand aur Jupiter ki escape speeds mein itna farq kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: v_esc = √(2GM/R) falaki jism ke mass aur radius par munhasir hai. Chaand ka mass kam hai is liye sirf 2.4 km s⁻¹, jabke bhaari Jupiter ki 61 km s⁻¹ (table).

book_ref.quote: For Your Information: Some Escape speeds (km s⁻¹)

blocks.prompt:
51 A planet has g = 3.7 m s⁻² at its surface and radius 3.4 × 10⁶ m. Find the escape velocity from it.
(Aik planet ki satah par g = 3.7 m s⁻² aur radius 3.4 × 10⁶ m hai. Us se escape velocity nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: where M and R are the mass and radius of the Earth respectively.

blocks.prompt:
52 State the work-energy theorem and write it as an equation.
(Work-energy theorem bayan karein aur masawat ki shakal mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Jism ki kinetic energy mein tabdeeli us par net force ke work ke barabar hai:
W = Fd = (K.E.)f − (K.E.)i = ½mvf² − ½mvi²

book_ref.quote: The change in kinetic energy of an object is equal to the work done on it by a net force.

blocks.prompt:
53 Is the work-energy theorem valid when the force is opposite to the motion, or when the force varies? Explain.
(Kya work-energy theorem tab bhi durust hai jab force harkat ke ulat ho ya badalti rahe? Wazahat karein.)

book_ref.quote: For instance, an object with kinetic energy can perform work if it is allowed to push or pull on another object.

blocks.prompt:
57 Show that the total energy of a freely falling body remains mgh at a point where it has fallen a distance x.
(Dikhayein ke azadana girte jism ki kul energy x faasla girne ke baad bhi mgh rehti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
B par P.E. = mg(h − x). vB² = 2gx se K.E. = mgx.
Kul energy = mg(h − x) + mgx = mgh, shuru jitni (hawa ki ragar nahi).

book_ref.quote: Total energy at position B = P.E. + K.E.

blocks.prompt:
58 Show that just before a falling body strikes the ground, its K.E. equals its original P.E.
(Dikhayein ke girta jism zameen se takrane se zara pehle us ki K.E. asal P.E. ke barabar hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
C par P.E. = 0 aur vC² = 2gh.
K.E. = ½m × 2gh = mgh, yani A par asal P.E.

book_ref.quote: Thus, at point C, kinetic energy is equal to the original value of the potential energy of the body.

blocks.prompt:
59 Write the relation between loss in P.E. and gain in K.E. for a falling body. When is it true?
(Girte jism ke liye P.E. ke nuqsan aur K.E. ke faide ka rishta likhein. Yeh kab durust hai?)
blocks.explanation: P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka faida: mg(h₁ − h₂) = ½m(v₂² − v₁²), jahan v₁, v₂ oonchaiyon h₁, h₂ par velocities hain. Yeh sirf tab durust hai jab friction shamil na ho.

book_ref.quote: This result is true only when frictional force is not considered.

blocks.prompt:
60 How is the energy equation of a falling body changed when air friction f is present?
(Hawa ki ragar f mojood ho to girte jism ki energy ki masawat kaise badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
P.E. ka kuch hissa friction ke khilaf fh work mein lagta hai; sirf baqi mgh − fh K.E. banta hai:
mgh = ½mv² + fh, yani P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka faida + friction ke khilaf work.

book_ref.quote: then a part of P.E. is used in doing work against friction equal to f h
